The University of Mumbai, established in 1857, is one of India’s oldest and most prestigious institutions. It offers a diverse range of undergraduate, postgraduate, and doctoral programs across disciplines such as science, commerce, arts, management, engineering, law, and social sciences.  ￼ ￼

The university operates primarily from two campuses: the Fort Campus, known for its historic Rajabai Clock Tower, and the expansive Kalina Campus, which spans 243 acres and provides a serene environment conducive to learning and research.  ￼

Students have access to comprehensive facilities, including separate hostels for boys and girls, well-furnished rooms, spacious classrooms, and full-time internet connectivity.  The Jawaharlal Nehru Library serves as a central resource, housing an extensive collection of academic materials.  ￼ ￼

The university has produced notable alumni who have significantly contributed to various fields. However, some students have expressed concerns regarding placement opportunities, citing limited campus recruitment and lower salary packages.  Despite these challenges, the University of Mumbai remains a prominent educational institution, blending historical significance with academic diversity. ￼

featured_reviews.name: Charlotte Sen
featured_reviews.review_text:
A significant part of my professional journey has SCM at its foundation. The course opened up a world I had very little exposure to at the time and, more importantly, shaped the way I think. It taught me to question, analyse, validate, and look beyond the obvious, skills that have stayed with me across every phase of my career.

The exposure to multiple disciplines: Film, Television, Journalism, Advertising, and PR, along with learning from accomplished industry professionals, gave the course both depth and strong real-world relevance. It prepared me not just for a profession, but for navigating complex, high-pressure environments.

My early career, spanning over 12 years in television production, saw me working as a Senior Executive Producer on some of India’s most recognised shows, including Kaun Banega Crorepati, Koffee with Karan, Rendezvous with Simi Garewal, Cover Story with Vir Sanghvi, Jhalak Dikhla Jaa, Entertainment Ke Liye Kuch Bhi Karega, Boogie Woogie, and Saavdhan India—as well as large-scale events like the Filmfare Awards, Femina Miss India, and STAR Parivar Awards. The ability to think critically, tell compelling stories, and manage complex productions can be traced back to my time at SCM.

Even as my career evolved into education and leadership, that grounding in communication, storytelling, and audience understanding continues to influence how I design learning experiences and lead teams.

SCM doesn’t just prepare you for a job; it builds a way of thinking. And that, in my experience, makes all the difference!
